title: 7 第七章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着村庄声望的提升，更多任务开始向都竞华开放。

饭馆的厨师夸张地打了个哈欠，对着都竞华露出开朗的笑容：“不断做饭让人深感疲惫，我现在想要休息。亲爱的朋友，你看起来精神奕奕，愿意帮我……”

都竞华一本正经：“错觉，只是角度问题，否则你应该能看见我的黑眼圈。”

厨师：“……”

都竞华：“不过帮个忙的话倒是可以，想来点什么？”

总觉得被玩弄了情感的厨师：“……五份兔子肉。”顿了下，补充，“我会为你的工作提供合适的酬劳。”

虽然“合适的酬劳”存在画饼的嫌疑，都竞华还是答应了下来。村外的兔子是一级怪，不会主动攻击，接取[兔肉]任务后还能拿到一副白板弓箭。

白板弓箭的属性当然不如水晶长弓，却很适合用来掩饰自身的实力。而且在拿到白板弓箭后，都竞华顺便解锁了村庄铁匠处的武器售卖功能。

出发打兔子之前，都竞华先去铁匠那边刷了下存在感。

铁匠铺靠近村庄中心，都竞华进门时，铁匠正躺在椅子上打盹，听见客人的脚步声向着自己靠近才睁开眼睛。

等了解到客户的需求后，铁匠回答：“需要购买箭矢的话，可以给你打八折。”

都竞华露出最诚恳的表情：“谢谢您的好意，但我现在更希望能学习箭矢的制作方法。”

玩单机的时候，都竞华只要操作下按键就可以，但现在沉浸式跑腿，副本连带着也会考验下玩家的社交能力。

幸好她i得不算厉害。

铁匠看了都竞华一眼，耳朵尖微微动了一下，一时间未置可否。

——村庄中的居民外表很像人类，但轮廓更加深刻，身材也更高大，皮肤的色泽也隐有不同，双方最大的区别是村民耳朵上有一个明显的尖角。游戏机时期，有玩家查过资料，怀疑村民身上具备妖精的血统。《失落大陆》中存在着各种各样的妖精，跟村庄有关的大概率是森林妖精。

箭矢的制作方法可以通过图纸解锁，可惜打怪的图纸掉落率很低，交易所中的价格不出意外一定被炒得很高，所以都竞华想试试看，能不能从npc这边直接将技能学过来。

她在评论中看见有人做到过。

铁匠没拒绝，慢吞吞道：“那你要先帮我个忙。”

NPC指着角落里的各种器具，道：“这是村民之前订购的东西，你帮我送去给他们。”

都竞华一一了解过去，问清订购人位置后，就陆续将那些落满灰尘的厨刀、沾着泥土的捕鼠器、经过修理的锤子、添加了蔬菜图案的剃头刀等分别送到对应的村民手上。

因为那些物品大多放了很长时间，看着并不干净，在送去之前，都竞华还特地清洁整理了一番。

铁匠默默旁观都竞华干活，等她将最后一件东西送完后，才道：“制作箭矢非常简单，只需要……”

都竞华认真听着，三分钟后，提示刷出——

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As the reputation of the village increases, more tasks begin to be opened to Du Jinghua.

The chef of the restaurant yawned exaggeratedly and showed a cheerful smile to Du Jinghua: "Continuous cooking makes people very tired. I want to rest now. My dear friend, you look energetic and willing to help me..."

Du Jinghua said seriously: "The illusion is just a matter of angle, otherwise you should be able to see the dark circles under my eyes."

Chef: "..."

Du Jinghua: "But it's okay if I can do you a favor. What do you want?"

The chef who always felt that his emotions were being played on said: "...five portions of rabbit meat." After a pause, he added, "I will provide you with appropriate remuneration for your work."

Although the "appropriate remuneration" was suspected of being unfair, Du Jinghua still agreed.The rabbit outside the village is a level one monster and will not attack actively. After accepting the [Rabbit Meat] mission, you can also get a whiteboard bow and arrow.

Of course, the properties of the whiteboard bow and arrow are not as good as the crystal longbow, but it is very suitable for concealing one's own strength.And after getting the whiteboard bow and arrow, Du Jinghua unlocked the weapon sales function at the village blacksmith.

Before setting off to hunt rabbits, Du Jinghua first went to the blacksmith to check his presence.

The blacksmith shop was close to the center of the village. When Du Jinghua came in, the blacksmith was lying on a chair and taking a nap. He opened his eyes when he heard the footsteps of his customer approaching him.

After understanding the customer's needs, the blacksmith replied: "If you need to buy arrows, I can give you a 20% discount."

Du Jinghua showed the most sincere expression: "Thank you for your kindness, but now I hope to learn how to make arrows."

When playing stand-alone, Du Jinghua only needs to press the buttons, but now the immersive errands and dungeons will also test the player's social skills.

Fortunately, she is not too bad at it.

The blacksmith glanced at Du Jinghua, the tips of his ears moved slightly, and he did not comment for a moment.

——The residents in the village look very much like humans, but their outlines are deeper, their stature is taller, and their skin color is also slightly different. The biggest difference between the two sides is that the villagers have an obvious sharp point on their ears.During the game console era, some players checked the information and suspected that the villagers had the blood of goblins.There are various kinds of fairies in "Lost Continent", and the ones related to villages are most likely forest fairies.

The arrow making method can be unlocked through blueprints. Unfortunately, the drop rate of the blueprints for killing monsters is very low. Unsurprisingly, the price on the exchange must be very high, so Du Jinghua wanted to try and see if he could directly learn the skills from the NPC.

She saw someone in the comments doing it.

The blacksmith did not refuse and said slowly: "Then you have to do me a favor first."

The NPC pointed to the various utensils in the corner and said, "This is what the villagers ordered before. Please help me deliver it to them."

Du Jinghua learned about the past one by one, and after asking for the location of the orderer, he successively delivered the dusty kitchen knives, mud-stained mousetraps, repaired hammers, razors with vegetable patterns, etc. to the corresponding villagers.

Because most of those items had been stored for a long time and did not look clean, Du Jinghua specially cleaned them before sending them away.

The blacksmith silently watched Du Jinghua work. After she delivered the last thing, he said: "Making arrows is very simple, you only need..."

Du Jinghua listened carefully. Three minutes later, a prompt appeared——
